purpose: Route substantive sources discovered while completing the 13524-tail raw scan for 99953, 99335, 52774 and 75472, including current 2026 chromium-telluride phase engineering and high-order-harmonic generation methodology, without promoting their identifiers as Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Mirrors, repository copies and alternate bibliographic pages for the same publication are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Repository IDs, chemical ontology IDs, article IDs, DOI components, page numbers and unitless instrumental table values are not Glob evidence unless the matched digits independently encode a verified physical quantity under the declared gate.

sources.title: Enhancing the efficiency of high-order harmonics with two-color non-collinear wave mixing in silica
sources.note: Use two-color non-collinear wave mixing and high-order-harmonic generation in a solid as a strong-field/ultrafast optical-control validation reference. 52774 is DOI metadata.

sources.title: Comparison of isoprene chemical mechanisms under atmospheric night-time conditions in chamber experiments
sources.authority: Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics / NOAA repository
sources.note: Use chamber-measurement versus mechanism-comparison workflow and mass-spectrometric product-trace validation as a model/data reconciliation benchmark. 52774 is the repository identifier.

sources.title: Structures of the ATP-fueled ClpXP proteolytic machine bound to protein substrate
sources.note: Use conformational-state structural reconstruction as an imaging/structure-validation precedent. 52774 is the article identifier.

sources.note: Use phase-controlled MBE synthesis plus STM/STS, STEM, DFT, XPS/XAS and magnetic imaging as a high-value programmable-material phase-engineering benchmark. 75472 is DOI metadata.

sources.note: Use linked MS/IR/Raman records as a spectral-data pointer; 75472 itself is a compound identifier.

information_updates.finding: The raw scan exposed a measured Raman intensity-area entry equal to 52774, but without a declared physical unit/semantic family suitable for the Glob P1 gate. Worldshepherd therefore separates measured instrumental numerics from admissible physical-value evidence.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Experimental origin alone is insufficient for P1 when the quantity semantics/unit family are undefined.

information_updates.finding: The 2026 chromium-telluride work demonstrates phase-controlled synthesis of several atomically thin Cr-Te phases on graphene/SiC and validates them with complementary structural, electronic, chemical and magnetic techniques.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This improves Worldshepherd materials methodology but contributes zero Glob evidence through the 75472 identifier.

information_updates.finding: The 2024 silica HHG study provides a solid-state strong-field control reference using two-color non-collinear wave mixing to enhance high-order harmonic generation.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 52774 is DOI metadata and is not the harmonic order or field parameter.
